inputs.xtext_rule_text:
BehaviorUsageElement returns SysML::Usage :
	  ActionUsage
	| CalculationUsage
	| StateUsage
	| ConstraintUsage
	| RequirementUsage
	| ConcernUsage
	| CaseUsage
	| AnalysisCaseUsage
	| VerificationCaseUsage
	| UseCaseUsage
	| ViewpointUsage
	| PerformActionUsage
	| ExhibitStateUsage
	| IncludeUseCaseUsage
	| AssertConstraintUsage
	| SatisfyRequirementUsage
;

decision: SysML 8.2.2.6.4 states BehaviorUsageElement : Usage = ActionUsage | CalculationUsage | StateUsage | ConstraintUsage | RequirementUsage | ConcernUsage | CaseUsage | AnalysisCaseUsage | VerificationCaseUsage | UseCaseUsage | ViewpointUsage | PerformActionUsage | ExhibitStateUsage | IncludeUseCaseUsage | AssertConstraintUsage | SatisfyRequirementUsage. The SysML Xtext is identical. The rule is the clause as written.
